bias.en: Bearish · oversold, closed at the low under $1,365
bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖，收于全日低位，跌破 $1,365

read.en: ASML fell 9.3% on Nov 5 to $1,356.65, trading $1,355.05–1,443.48 on 2.5 times its 20-day average volume and closing near the low. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,499.43), 10-day ($1,563.39), 30-day ($1,681.75) and 100-day ($1,728.24) and the rising 200-day ($1,600.00). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,618.67), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: 阿斯麦 11月5日下跌 9.3%，收于 $1,356.65，盘中区间 $1,355.05–1,443.48，成交量为 20 日均量的 2.5 倍，收于全日低位附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$1,499.43）、10 日（$1,563.39）、30 日（$1,681.75）和 100 日均线（$1,728.24）以及上行的 200 日均线（$1,600.00）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月13日起看空（$1,618.67），RSI 为 27，处于超卖区。

read.en: The gap lower broke the $1,479–1,493.5 and $1,450 supports and the $1,364.8 Apr 28 low; the close is the lowest since Apr 7. Resistance is $1,364.8, then $1,441.3–1,443.5 (May 19 low, Nov 5 high) and $1,479–1,499 (Nov 4 low, 5-day). Support is $1,329–1,333.6 (Mar 3 and Mar 12 lows), then $1,311–1,316 (Jan 20 and Feb 4 lows). A close above $1,365 would target $1,441–1,443; below $1,329, $1,311–1,316.
